skills.name: Kochi
skills.description: Attacks the enemy with aiki energy from both hands. Bad effects on enemies.  *Enemy ATK Speed -30% (10 sec) *Enemy Skill Resistance -30% (10 sec) *ATK x 3300% Area Damage

skills.name: Tamamo
skills.description: Quickly swings arms to create wind all around. Good effects on allies.  *Removes allies' debuffs  *Move Speed +180% (7 sec) *Skill Evade Rate +50% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Yozakura
abilities.description: Yozakura Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Ally Clone
abilities.description: Has a set chance of summoning 1 allied team Ranger when Rangers deploy.　  - Flyer and Air Ambush Rangers are not eligible to be summoned in this way.  - The Abilities of allied Rangers summoned by this Ability won't activate. - Summoned Rangers won't consume any Mineral and will have no effects on redeploy times.
